name: @dean_overlord/hesdor
description: Hesdor terminal UI and CLI entrypoint

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --input-type=module -e "import { build } from 'esbuild'; import { readFileSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs'; const { version } = JSON.parse(readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')); rmSync('dist/chunks', { recursive: true, force: true }); await build({ entryPoints: { bundle: 'dist/cli.js' }, bundle: true, splitting: true, platform: 'node', format: 'esm', outdir: 'dist', chunkNames: 'chunks/[name]-[hash]', external: ['ink', 'ink-text-input', 'react'], define: { __HESDOR_VERSION__: JSON.stringify(version) }, logLevel: 'warning' })"
